claim_one_line: THE WEAVE'S GROUP IS THE ONE-QUBIT CLIFFORD GROUP MODULO PHASES (P-223): the moves induce automorphisms of the common point Q8; L and R generate all of Aut(Q8) = S4 (order 24, element orders 1:1, 2:9, 3:8, 4:6), the octahedral rotation group on the three axes, which is the one-qubit Clifford group modulo phases; B1611's G (order 96) has centre Z4 and G/Z = Aut(Q8) by an isomorphism matching L and R. L and R are quarter turns about two axes (phase-gate type), the rule sigma = L o P is the third of a turn about the body diagonal (the T-type magic axis), the swap a half turn about a face diagonal (Hadamard type). Correcting P-223's wording: on the common point the swap is a rotation, not anti-symplectic; over F2 the two coincide, and the swap's reversal shows only on H1 and in the lift (T to T-bar, B1611). No number of the 19. 0 of 19.
